description: Weak thesis: aim without problem, question or hypotheses; nine sources, mostly websites, none foreign; a convenience survey generalised to all Poles.

metadata.author: Marek Zieliński
metadata.title: Wpływ kryptowalut na system finansowy w Polsce

expected.issue: The introduction states only a general aim: there is no research problem, no research question and no hypothesis.
The bibliography has far fewer than the 25 required sources; most entries are websites (netography), which do not count.
There are no foreign-language sources; at least four are required.
The survey is not described as a research method: no sample size, no selection criteria, no questionnaire, no numbers in the results — only 'znajomi autora' via social media.
The conclusion generalises from a convenience sample of the author's acquaintances to 'Polacy' as a whole, and claims more than the vague results show.
The introduction is missing required elements: scope (subject, time, place), description of the methods, and a characterisation of the literature.

must_not_flag: The thesis has no conclusions chapter (Zakończenie) at all.
The thesis has no table of contents.
The thesis has no independence statement (oświadczenie).
